issues: The question 8 OCR text contains question 7's <資料> figure data (準住居地域150㎡, 建蔽率, 敷地面積200㎡, etc.) after the 語群, so the figure placement is broken.
The answer reasoning itself is correct: 課税主体 is 市町村 (東京23区は都), the 賦課期日 is January 1, the 小規模住宅用地 limit is 200㎡ per dwelling unit, and 課税標準 is 1/6. The special rule is unchanged as of 2024-04-01.
The draft does not explain why the distractors are wrong (国・都道府県, 4月1日, 240㎡, 3分の1). The 3分の1 rule is for 一般住宅用地 (the part over 200㎡), so it is easy to confuse, and this reason should be added.
suggestedCorrection: Remove the question 7 figure data from the question 8 text and move it to question 7. Add to the explanation: '(ア) 固定資産税 is a 市町村税 (地方税法 第342条); in the 23 wards 東京都 levies it (第734条). It is not a 国税 or 都道府県税. (イ) The 賦課期日 is January 1 (第359条); April 1 is the start of the fiscal year, not the 賦課期日. (ウ)(エ) The 小規模住宅用地 is the part up to 200㎡ per dwelling unit, with 課税標準 = 評価額×1/6 (第349条の3の2). The part over 200㎡ (一般住宅用地) is 1/3, so 3分の1 is wrong. 240㎡ is not a threshold of this special rule.'

issues: The (ア) reason could also note that since the 2022 amendment (借地借家法38条2項) the contract can be made by 電磁的記録. As of 2024-04-01, a 電磁的記録 counts as 書面 (38条2項), so the answer is still 2.

The draft does not explain why the distractors are wrong (3 公正証書に限る, 5 正当事由の有無にかかわらず, 7・8 みなし期間). Also, the (エ) reason does not cite the provision that removes any upper limit on 建物賃貸借 terms (29条2項 excludes 民法604条).
suggestedCorrection: Add: '(ア) 38条1項 says 公正証書による等書面によって, so the contract is not limited to 公正証書 and 3 is wrong. (イ) Under 28条, a 更新拒絶 by the landlord requires 正当事由, so 5 is wrong. (ウ) Under 29条1項, a 普通借家 term of less than 1 year is treated as a lease with no fixed term, so the 1-year and 2-year みなし options are wrong. (エ) 29条2項 excludes 民法604条 (50-year cap), and a 定期借家 can set any term under 38条1項, so there is no upper or lower limit.'

issues: The choice reasons say only '4.71%でなく4.25%'. They do not say where 4.71% comes from: (1,680,000−360,000)÷28,000,000≒4.71%, the incorrect figure you get if 固定資産税・都市計画税 is left out of the costs. The distractor reasoning is thin.
The rounding check is fine: 1,190,000÷28,000,000×100＝4.25 exactly. The 管理業務委託費 is 140,000×5%＝7,000円 per month, and the calculation is correct.
suggestedCorrection: Choice 2 and 4 reason: '4.71% is (1,680,000−360,000)÷28,000,000, which leaves 固定資産税・都市計画税 of 130,000円 out of 運営コスト. The 実質利回り deducts all annual costs including taxes, so the correct figure is 4.25%.' Add to the (イ)(ウ) reason: 'The 元金 portion is repayment of borrowed money and is not an expense. The building part is recovered through 減価償却費 instead.'
